incident_reference_policy: Measured empty-domain directional incident Poynting flux; shared across every structure on this mesh. No Fresnel gain correction and no mark-dependent scaling.
remaining_seven_variants: variantid_fine: real100fs maximum; explicitly reused air_fine, actual simulation time and late residual retained in DONE/manifest

time_validation.criterion: Task concerns integrated scan: total field<0.1% and scan<0.2%; both satisfied. Nonzero-band complex field alone has0.2338% residual and is not claimed<0.1%.

spatial_validation.meaning: Mesh residual remains. Actual source-only beam waist is19.00001um. No post-hoc Fresnel correction is applied.

further_control.meaning: Y spatial grid and associated time step are refined; X-PML physical width also increases. No claim that only a single scalar parameter changes. All actual PML coefficients and geometry are read from native FSP audit.

extra_weak_holdout.geometry: AH53 height180nm with planar SiO2 cap400nm, top580nm; original8 structures remain unchanged
extra_weak_holdout.fit_policy: Independent held-out structure; never included in any calibration of shared instrument parameters
extra_weak_holdout.time_policy: Compare actual100/200/400fs scans using this weak case's own small dynamic span; do not reuse strong-case absolute-error tolerances

100fs_time_failure.meaning: 100fs failed for this weak curve; the quick time audit uses nearest-band P0 and is a diagnostic, not the final source-mode-zero comparison.

200_to_400fs_time_validation.branch: Quick nearest-band P0 one-time scalar term. Final source-projected-mode-zero branch is independently calculated by the main analysis pipeline; these diagnostics do not replace it.

extra_weak_holdout.cancelled_finerY100fs: An incomplete32.165fs finer-grid attempt was intentionally stopped after the100fs temporal failure. CANCELLED.json and logs are preserved; it has no DONE or field export and is never used as spatial-convergence evidence.

engine_policy: One native CPU engine at a time; one process, eight threads. Full six-component raw line E/H, model FSP, standalone LSF, and actual-time logs retained.
